chapter.title: Gathering information for support

info.meta: Gather system information for support and locate important log files for this product

chapter.para: When you encounter issues with your &sap; environment, you can use the following tools and log files to gather diagnostic data and provide them to &suse; support.

sect1.title: Using the supportconfig utility
sect1.para: Gather system information that can provide details about problems in your system to the &suse; support, using the supportconfig utility.

For &sap; and &ha; environments, you can install the supportutils-plugin-ha-sap package before gathering the supportconfig archive. This plug-in extends the archive to include diagnostic data specific to &sap; applications and &ha; clusters.
To learn more details about using this plug-in, see the &suse; Knowledge Base article Details for supportconfig plugin to gather &sap; information related to &suse; solutions.
For general &sls; information about gathering system information and uploading archives to the &suse; support, see the article Gathering System Information for Support.

sect1.title: Important log files
sect1.para: The most important log files for this product can be found as follows:

listitem.para: The &sapwiz; is a &yast; module. You can find its log entries in /var/log/YaST/y2log.
All &sap; knowledge is bundled in a library. You can find its log entries in /var/log/SAPmedia.log.
You can find log files related to auto-installation in /var/adm/autoinstall/logs.
